body: rehypeGlossary (packages/mdx-viewer/src/rehypeGlossary.ts) MUST build <abbr> nodes in the hast tree at parse time, never by mutating mounted DOM. Post-mount text-node mutation caused the 'Failed to execute insertBefore on Node' React-reconciliation race (commit 5f8ea12). Never revert to DOM mutation. It skips code/pre/abbr/a/headings/script/style/.katex*/.fv-define to avoid double-wrap.
